title: Prediction Market Artifact Validator
description: Validates pm:* prediction/event-market provenance artifacts against the registered OpenChainGraph schema (SPEC.md §5.1), recomputes execution_hash client-side, and renders the chain.parent_hashes flow. Format checker only — no oracle, no settlement, no market of any kind.

artifact_json.description: A single pm:* OpenChainGraph artifact, or a JSON array of them forming a chain

mcp_tool_definition.name: validate_pm_artifact
mcp_tool_definition.description: Validates one or more pasted pm:* (prediction/event-market provenance) OpenChainGraph artifacts against the registered SPEC.md §5.1 schema, recomputes execution_hash client-side via the canonical _hash.mjs algorithm, and reports the chain.parent_hashes linkage. Deterministic rule-based checks only — no oracle logic.

artifact_json.description: A single pm:* artifact JSON object, or a JSON array of them
